name: Special Meeting of the City Council
agenda_text:
PLEASE TAKE NOTICE, this special meeting of the City Council has been called by the
Mayor pursuant to Government Code section 54956. Public comments may also be
submitted by email at publiccomments@cityofartesia.us before 12:00 p.m. on the date of
the meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING OF THE ARTESIA CITY COUNCIL
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  18747 CLARKDALE AVENUE
  ARTESIA, CA 90701
  (562) 865-6262

  YOU MAY VIEW THIS MEETING LIVE OVER THE INTERNET AT
  https://artesia.12milesout.com/livevideo

  MONDAY, JUNE 5, 2023
  5:30 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER SPECIAL MEETING

ROLL CALL

ANNOUNCEMENT REGARDING PUBLIC COMMENTS
Anyone wishing to speak to the City Council is asked to fill out a speaker card and submit
it to the City Clerk prior to the commencement of the meeting. Any public comments that
cannot be heard within the next 20 minutes will be heard at the end of the meeting. Under
California law, public comments at special meetings are limited to subjects on the agenda
only. Under the provisions of the Brown Act, the City Council is prohibited from taking action
on items that are not listed on the agenda, but may refer the matter to staff or to a
subsequent meeting.

CLOSED SESSION
 1. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL- EXISTING LITIGATION
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9(D)(1)
  NUMBER OF CASES: 1
  CATALYST – ARTESIA LLC V. CITY OF ARTESIA
  LOS ANGELES SUPERIOR COURT CASE NO. 23STCP00671

2. CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54957.6
  AGENCY DESIGNATED REPRESENTATIVE: CITY MANAGER

  EMPLOYEE ORGANIZATION: AMERICAN FEDERATION OF STATE, CITY, AND
  MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES, AFL-CIO, LOCAL 1520, MANAGERS AND
  SUPERVISORS UNIT, COUNCIL 36.

  EMPLOYEE ORGANIZATION: AMERICAN FEDERATION OF STATE, CITY, AND
  MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES, AFL-CIO, LOCAL 1520, GENERAL UNIT, COUNCIL 36
 PUBLIC HEARING
 3. CONSIDERATION AND FIRST READING OF ORDINANCE NOS. 23-943 AND 23-
  944 RELATING TO COMMERCIAL CANNABIS USES

  ORDINANCE NO. 23-943, REGARDING ARTICLES 20 AND 44 OF CHAPTER 2 OF
  TITLE 9 OF THE ARTESIA MUNICIPAL CODE, ESTABLISHING AN
  ADMINISTRATIVE  DESIGN  REVIEW  FOR  COMMERCIAL  CANNABIS
  BUSINESSES,  AND  REAFFIRMING  THAT  COMMERCIAL  CANNABIS
  BUSINESSES MAY BE A PERMITTED USE SUBJECT TO THE REVIEW AND
  APPROVAL OF VARIOUS ENTITLEMENTS WITHIN THE COMMERCIAL
  GENERAL, COMMERCIAL PLANNED DEVELOPMENT, ARTESIA BOULEVARD
  SPECIFIC PLAN, ARTESIA BOULEVARD CORRIDOR SPECIFIC PLAN, AND
  SOUTH STREET SPECIFIC PLAN ZONES THAT ARE SOUTH OF CALIFORNIA
  STATE ROUTE 91 (ARTESIA FREEWAY);

  ORDINANCE NO. 23-944, AMENDING AND RESTATING ARTICLE 8 OF CHAPTER
  2 OF TITLE 3 OF THE ARTESIA MUNICIPAL CODE RELATING TO ADULT
  CANNABIS BUSINESS AND ACTIVITIES AND MAKING A DETERMINATION OF
  EXEMPTION FROM CEQA PURSUANT TO STATE CEQA GUIDELINES 15060(c)(2)
  and 15061(b)(3)
  STAFF REPORT  ATTACHMENT

CITY MANAGER INFORMATIONAL REPORTING

COUNCILMEMBER COMMENTS
This is the time for Councilmembers to report on external boards and committee meetings
attended and meetings attended at public expense. Additional general comments,
announcements, and requests of staff and/or other issues of concern to Councilmembers
may also be presented at this time.

ADJOURNMENT

The City of Artesia complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special
assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk’s office at 562-865-
6262 at least 24 hours prior to the meeting. Copies of Staff Reports are on file in the Office of the
City Clerk and are available for inspection.
